method: See style-guides.md. Pages were read through web-search excerpts only (direct page fetching was blocked by the environment's network policy); every figure was taken from an excerpt attributed to the cited page. Computed values are flagged in notes.

styles.traits_en: Long thin lean loaf of wheat flour, water, salt and yeast (French 'tradition' rules allow only these plus levain and three minor flour adjuncts, no additives, no freezing); thin crisp crust from a hot, steamed hearth bake and an open crumb, usually with a poolish.
styles.consensus: strong for proportions (four formulas agree within a few points); weak for bulk and proof times (not tied to a source in what could be read)

styles.traits_en: Round lean loaf baked in a preheated covered pot that traps steam for the first part of the bake, then uncovered to brown; higher hydration than a baguette and either a slow low-yeast fermentation or a cold rest.
styles.consensus: moderate: hydration and salt agree; yeast depends on the schedule (low yeast with long room bulk, or more yeast with a cold rest); bake temperature from one source only

styles.traits_en: Oily pan flatbread, dimpled before baking. Two families: Genoese (fugassa) at moderate hydration with oil in the dough and a water-oil-salt brine on top; and the high-hydration pan focaccia of US home baking.
styles.consensus: two distinct families; within each the sources agree, but the template mixes them (Genoese label, high-hydration numbers)

reference_rules.name: AVPN Verace Pizza Napoletana (true Neapolitan)
reference_rules.water_per_flour: 1 litre of water per 1.6-1.8 kg of flour, i.e. about 55.6-62.5 % hydration [3]
reference_rules.salt: 40-60 g per litre of water, i.e. about 2.2-3.75 % of flour [3]
reference_rules.yeast: 0.1-3 g fresh brewer's yeast per litre of water (about 0.006-0.19 % of flour); dry yeast at one third of the fresh weight; sourdough 5-20 % of flour [3]
reference_rules.flour: soft wheat type 00 (2019+ editions also allow 0 and 1, per forum reports [75]), W 250-320 in the 2024 edition [1], W 250-310 in 2022
reference_rules.fermentation: 12-24 h in total at 16-22 C, controlled cells at 18-20 C and 60-70 % humidity allowed (2024) [2]; older editions: about 2 h bulk then 4-6 h in balls at 20-25 C [2, 5]
reference_rules.bake: wood-fired dome about 485 C, floor about 380-430 C [1]; oven at 430-480 C [4]; 60-90 s [1, 4]
